concerns.text: Phase 0 (Data Availability Check) is not linked to any functional requirement (FR) or success criterion (SC) in the specification, making it an unanchored planning step.
Phase 8 (Reporting & Figures) has no corresponding FR or SC; the spec only requires a final CSV output (FR‑007) and does not mandate figure generation.
Phase 9 (Lint Check) is not referenced by any FR/SC; linting is a quality‑control activity but not a required deliverable per the spec.
Phase 10 (Contract Verification) is not mapped to any FR or SC; while contract tests are useful, the spec does not explicitly require a separate verification phase.
Phase 11 (Runtime Guard) lacks a direct FR/SC anchor; the spec mentions compute feasibility but does not prescribe an automatic down‑sampling guard.
